title: AgroFi
tagline: This is a staking contract which gives reward per token , to user
description:
this is a staking contract which gives reward per token , keeps track of how much user has staked 
also how much token user has and then transfer the token to the contract , it checks between 12 - 1pm , user earned X tokens. Needs to verify time staked to distribute correct amount to each
   participant
